item.title: Why High-Functioning People In Hawaiʻi Are Quietly Struggling With Anxiety
item.description: Cultural and social expectations can further complicate recognition of both anxiety and substance use.

item.title: Waiʻanae Group Wants A New Homeless Shelter. Can They Overcome Objections?
item.description: Disagreements include whether more services will help current Westside homeless or if they will just become a magnet for more.

item.title: Governor Wants New Laws To Protect Immigrants — Fast
item.description: Lawmakers were surprised by his comments, which came after a rally at the Capitol where hundreds protested ICE and the killings of protesters.

item.title: Honolulu Bus, Rail Fares Set To Go Up This Summer
item.description: Council members voted Wednesday to boost the cost of an adult bus pass by $10 a month, along with other price hikes.

item.title: Crucial Hawaiʻi County Commissions Stymied By Members’ No-Shows
item.description: Planning commissioners are debating new rules to tighten up attendance requirements despite some pushback.

item.title: Word Row: Jan. 29
item.description: Our six-letter version of the word game is just what you need right now.

item.title: Neal Milner: 6 Reasons Lawmakers Should Investigate One Of Their Own
item.description: The potential bribe is a public issue that touches the public in different ways. A legislative inquiry would allow the public to watch how it unfolded.

item.title: Hoʻokuʻu ʻIa Ka ʻOihana Mākaʻikaʻi Moku Ma Ka ʻĀpua Mai Ka Uku I Ko Hawaiʻi Uku Hoʻomauō Hou
item.description: Ua ʻōlelo nā luna kānāwai ʻaha hoʻoholo, ʻaʻole pono nā moku e halihali nei i nā ʻōhua i nā awa e uku i ka uku hoʻomauō hou i ka ʻaha e hoʻoholo ana.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Could See Nation’s Highest Drop In High School Graduates
item.description: The declining number of graduates from Hawaiʻi schools reflects larger concerns in the DOE about shrinking enrollment and the potential for school closures.

item.title: Fewer Hawaiʻi Homes Are Vacant As Number Of Households Grow
item.description: Hawai‘i residents are getting older and more of us are living with disabilities, according to the latest census data.
